name: io.github.pgg898200-ship-it/eproc
title: eproc
description: Sub-microsecond anytime-valid online statistical inference, multi-rate crossing-free conformal calibration, 640-byte distributed fleet monoids, and Byzantine-safe multi-agent fusion (zero-dependency C11 + Python stdio MCP server).

tools.name: eproc_etest
tools.description: Anytime-valid ONS betting e-process hypothesis test for bounded streams with Ville inequality safety under continuous peeking and optional stateful session_id.

tools.name: eproc_confidence_sequence
tools.description: Anytime-valid O(1) Empirical-Bernstein or Normal-Mixture confidence sequence with running-intersection tightening.

tools.name: eproc_race
tools.description: Anytime-valid multi-arm agent/model racer with automatic early elimination and FWER control.

tools.name: eproc_conformal
tools.description: Multi-rate crossing-free AgACI + Conformal PID online interval calibrator for up to 5 simultaneous coverage levels.

tools.name: eproc_cmonoid_merge
tools.description: Bit-exact associative and commutative distributed 640-byte conformal monoid merge and leave-one-out subtraction.

tools.name: eproc_safe_fuse
tools.description: Byzantine-safe Bernstein Online Aggregation (BOA) with 3-gate Ville e-process non-inferiority fallback and lock-free seqlocked weights.

tools.name: eproc_echopool
tools.description: Provenance-deduplicated multi-agent evidence pool with Beta-Bernoulli peer reliability tracking.
